maddeler.e:
ننسحب (form VII)
# نَنْسَحِبُ (nansaḥibu) /nan.sa.ħi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
# نَنْسَحِبَ (nansaḥiba) /nan.sa.ħi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
# نَنْسَحِبْ (nansaḥib) /nan.sa.ħib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
